gitCommit.subject: docs: the SPX operator-side fix is a committed build for 09-12, not an offer (#312)
gitCommit.body:
docs: the SPX operator-side fix is a committed build for 09-12, not an offer (#312)

Agenda item 4d read "Not started — it is a dispatch state-model change, not a bug
fix", which is accurate and reads as optional. Mukesh committed to it at the close
("we will pick tomorrows agenda alongwith the SPX fix"), and leaving a committed
decision looking optional is the same record failure as putting an open question
under a ✅ heading.

Records the case he made for it himself: Dispatch deliberately mirrors carrier
truth, so it still says "booked" — but that is the gap, because "Booked" now means
both "waiting for collection" and "collection was ATTEMPTED AND FAILED" and the
operator cannot tell them apart. Scope pinned so tomorrow does not re-litigate it.
